infos.title: 49 rue des Augustins. Until 5 am.
infos.accessText: Right in the centre of Amiens, a few minutes' walk from the cathedral. Parking: street spaces nearby and the city-centre car parks. On foot is even easier.
infos.mapTitle: Map: Avesta, 49 rue des Augustins, Amiens
infos.delivery: Delivery: Avesta is also on Deliveroo and Uber Eats.

items.a: Every day from 11 am to 5 am, weekends included. The “Open now” status at the top of the site updates live. Exceptional closures are announced in the banner.
Use the form on this site: pick your dishes, eat in or takeaway, and your time. You can also call +33 3 75 50 82 02 or just come to the counter.
When you order online, you choose your time: at the earliest 20 minutes after ordering. Your food is ready when you arrive.
You pay at the counter, when you collect or at the end of your meal. There's no online payment for now.
Yes, it's what Avesta is about. The full list is coming to the site soon: meanwhile, ask at the counter what's on today.
Not directly, but Avesta is on Deliveroo and Uber Eats. For the best price and hot fries, ordering here and dropping by is the easiest.

nuit.metaDescription: Eating late in Amiens: Avesta is open every day until 5 am, 49 rue des Augustins. Tacos, kebab, plates, Persian specialities, eat in or takeaway.
nuit.lead: Avesta is open every day from 11 am to 5 am, right in the centre of Amiens. For a meal after work, a post-party craving or a night of revision.

sections.p: Monday to Sunday, the kitchen runs from 11 am to 5 am. No closing day: just check the banner at the top of the site for exceptional closures.
Tacos, a kebab, a plate with fries and salad, a burger or a rice or pasta box. And, on some days, our Persian house specialities.

sections.h: Eat in, takeaway or by phone
sections.p: Sit down, pick up your order, or call +33 3 75 50 82 02. On the site, you choose your pick-up time, even in the middle of the night.
At 49 rue des Augustins, a few minutes' walk from the cathedral. Handy for walking home after a night out.

tacos.title: Tacos in Amiens

tacos.metaDescription: Tacos in Amiens, three sizes, from €7.99: chicken, kebab, tenders, cordon bleu, merguez… At Avesta, 49 rue des Augustins, open every day until 5 am.
tacos.lead: Grilled wrap, your choice of meat, sauces and fries inside. Three sizes, from €7.99, every day until 5 am.

sections.p: Chicken, kebab, tenders, nuggets, beef, cordon bleu, merguez or kefta. Add your sauce: white, Algerian, samurai, harissa, biggy, barbecue…
For a small appetite, a big one, or if you just can't decide. Tacos start at €7.99; larger sizes are priced at the counter.
Our fries come up a lot in customer reviews. Inside the tacos or on the side, they're there.
Order online and pick your time, or come straight to 49 rue des Augustins.
